title: What Gracey Left Behind

hints.text: Stay in Master Gracey's garden and inspect the old iron gazebo.
You're looking for a small group of personal objects, as if someone stood up and walked away.
Find the bench with a well-read book, an armillary sphere, and a pipe left in the gazebo.

revealDescription: Inside Master Gracey's wrought-iron gazebo are a bench, a worn book, an armillary sphere, and a pipe—quiet props that make the garden feel recently occupied.
